verdict.rationale: Shortcut's pricing page lists a first-party Figma integration, so the product does connect to a design tool. Nothing in the evidence shows that this integration lets a designer update story or project status from inside Figma; the REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documentation of what the Figma integration does, evidence that status can be viewed or updated from within Figma without switching apps, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
